Batch 1 of run `frontier-39-analysis-30` is scaffolded and **READY** for owner/operator reconciliation and Step-3 review.

## What I changed since the prior pass

The prior draft had silently weakened design item 15 (`thm-backward-heat-solution-map-is-unbounded`): it asserted only “explicit solution pairs” and disclaimed well-definedness, because its uniqueness attempt used an invalid time-reversal energy argument. I restored the design’s claim rather than shipping the weakening:

- **New A-page prerequisite** `lem-backward-uniqueness-for-the-heat-equation-on-a-bounded-interval` (level 0): Teschl Theorem 6.21’s log-convexity proof of backwards uniqueness, read in full from the stamped PDF and adapted to the interval class `C^{4,2}` **without an initial-face hypothesis** (the maximal-positivity-interval limit only needs `E(b)=0`, supplied by the terminal condition). All 14 published suppliers were opened and checked.
- **`thm-backward-heat-solution-map-is-unbounded`** now states both clauses: well-definedness of the terminal-to-initial map on the smooth class, and norm-unboundedness with amplification `e^{k²T}` — the design’s “norm-unbounded inverse”, the precise Hadamard failure.
- Re-worded the backward-ill-posed remark (removed its stale “uniqueness is the energy argument” line) and the B counterexample; updated the Teschl 6.21 coverage mapping to `included` for the new lemma (25 included / 10 inline / 10 already-published / 6 deferred / 12 out-of-scope), and trimmed A11’s locator to the forward energy computation only.
- Recorded everything in the batch notes (correction record, priority over the earlier draft; design-schema conflict, ordering deviation, prose-only PDE-24 orientation remain as before).
